snippet.title: Don't Get Fired! Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734300/Dont_Get_Fired/

The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!
